structures.label: Right kidney
structures.function: Paired retroperitoneal organ that filters blood and contributes to urine formation and homeostasis.

structures.label: Left kidney
structures.function: Paired retroperitoneal organ that filters blood and contributes to urine formation and homeostasis.

structures.label: Renal capsule
structures.function: Fibrous covering closely surrounding the kidney.

structures.label: Renal cortex
structures.function: Outer renal parenchyma containing renal corpuscles and portions of renal tubules.

structures.label: Renal medulla
structures.function: Inner renal region organized into renal pyramids.

structures.label: Renal pyramids
structures.function: Conical medullary structures that direct urine toward renal papillae.

structures.label: Renal papillae
structures.function: Apices of renal pyramids that drain urine into minor calyces.

structures.label: Major calyces
structures.function: Receive urine from groups of minor calyces and drain toward the renal pelvis.

structures.label: Renal pelvis
structures.function: Funnel-shaped proximal collecting structure continuous with the ureter.

structures.label: Ureter
structures.function: Conveys urine from the renal pelvis toward the urinary bladder.

structures.label: Renal artery
structures.function: Delivers arterial blood to the kidney through the renal hilum.

structures.label: Renal vein
structures.function: Drains venous blood from the kidney through the renal hilum.

structures.label: Renal hilum
structures.function: Medial gateway for renal vessels, nerves, lymphatics, and the renal pelvis.
